# FG-REVIEW-0032

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | [`auto-merge`](../../ops/runbooks/auto-merge.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `full_cannot_be_chosen_while_the_instance_does_not_allow_it` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: このサーバーでは完全自動マージ（full）が許可されていません。管理者が許可するまで、条件付き・予約・オフから選んでください。
- en: Full auto-merge is not allowed on this server. Until an administrator allows it, choose conditional, reserve or off.
- id: Merge otomatis penuh (full) tidak diizinkan di server ini. Sampai administrator mengizinkannya, pilih conditional, reserve, atau off.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 close (ADR-0017 Amendments 2026-10-30 B, 2026-11-03 B and 2026-11-17): an instance administrator turned the instance's `merge.allow_full_auto` off (`PUT /api/v1/admin/auto-merge/allow-full-auto` with `{"allowed": false}`), and a project Owner then asked `PUT /api/v1/projects/{id}/auto-merge` for `{"mode": "full"}`. The allowance is read under a shared lock on the instance row in the same transaction as the change, so nothing was written. While it is off, projects already `full` are `reserve` in effect: the auto-merge principal is refused (`FG-AUTH-0003 reason=full_auto_not_allowed`), their auto-merge queue entries leave the queue (`reason=full_auto_not_allowed`) and their merge requests show `held reason=full_auto_not_allowed`. Not a server fault.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The refusal is logged at the route with `request_id`, `error_code` and `project_id`. Read the allowance and who changed it (read-only): SELECT allow_full_auto, allow_full_auto_by, allow_full_auto_at FROM forge.auto_merge_instance; the change is the audit row `auto_merge.allow_full_auto_changed` (resource the instance). `forge doctor` line `review.auto_merge` shows the allowance and how many projects are set to `full`.

## 対処 (fix)

Choose `conditional`, `reserve` or `off`, or ask an instance administrator to allow full auto-merge (an administrator's web session, `PUT /api/v1/admin/auto-merge/allow-full-auto` with `{"allowed": true}`; runbook auto-merge). Projects left at `full` act again as soon as it is allowed.
